product.title: Beyond the Liberty Bell History Walking Tour

description.text: Go beyond the Liberty Bell on a history walking tour through Old City that reveals hidden stories and lesser-known Revolutionary sites. Your guide covers Independence Hall and the bell while diving into alleyways, burial grounds, and overlooked landmarks that shaped early Philadelphia. The two-hour format keeps a focused pace through downtown crime, commerce, and Colonial life. Suited for curious travelers who want deeper context than a standard Independence Mall visit.
